description:
Add the extra Python libraries your custom/OCA modules import (an SMS client, an AI SDK, a
    PDF tool...) to the stack's Odoo image, at the SAME versions as the source server, so those
    modules install and behave as before. Builds a derived image FROM the existing
    odoo-local:<version>-<edition> (or the official odoo:<version>), pip-installs the pins as root,
    checks each version and each `imports` name INSIDE the new image, and only then retags it
    (the previous image stays as <tag>-prev; on a failed check nothing changes).

    `packages`: 'name==version' pins, or bare 'name' when `source_host` is given - then the
    version is READ (read-only) from the source server's Python. A bare name the source does not
    have is refused: no guessing a version. After it: recreate the service (docker_stack_init or
    `up -d --force-recreate` through the tools) so the container runs the new image.
name: docker_image_pylibs
